scope: Pilot: curated glycerophospholipid class conversions; not a complete lipid metabolism database

pathways.label: Glycerophospholipid class conversions (pilot)
pathways.membership_method: MSLipidMapper curated grouping; not an imported complete Reactome pathway

rules.species_inclusion: Exact taxon and exact Rhea catalytic-activity annotation on a reviewed UniProt protein. Reviewed does not imply experimental confirmation.
rules.reaction_selection: Only explicit curated class reactions and individual PEMT stages. The lumped PE-to-PC reaction is excluded.
rules.unknown_direction: Retain UnknownDirection; do not infer irreversibility from a traversal arrow.
rules.unmeasured: Class membership does not imply a measured value or zero.
